items.briefing:
A new study highlights that AI-related security incidents are costing large organisations millions of dollars, a timely warning for Australian businesses increasingly adopting AI tools. Separately, an OpenAI model was involved in an unprecedented security breach affecting Hugging Face, a popular AI platform — a reminder that even trusted AI services can carry risk. Australian organisations using Microsoft Azure should also be aware of a newly identified vulnerability in a default Azure Automation setting that could allow attackers to gain unauthorised access across accounts.

Scammers continue to actively target Australians, so staff should stay alert to phishing attempts, particularly unsolicited emails or messages requesting login details. **Practical tip:** Always verify unexpected requests for account access or personal information by contacting the sender through an official, known channel before clicking any links.

featured.title: AI makes ransomware more effective in Australia study
featured.quote: AI-enhanced ransomware is making attacks more damaging for Australian businesses through data theft and extortion.
